blocks.text: New Year, Fresh Vision, Let’s Put Your Benefits to Good Use
blocks.html: New Year, Fresh Vision, Let’s Put Your Benefits to Good Use

With each new year comes a refreshed set of vision benefits. If your 2026 insurance plan or FSA just reset, now is the perfect time to prioritize your eye health. At Briargrove Eye Center, we help patients across Uptown Houston and the Galleria area use their coverage wisely on services that truly benefit their vision.
Whether you're due for an exam, considering contact lenses, or ready to update your look with a new pair of frames, our team is here to help you get the most value from your 2026 plan.
What Can Vision Benefits Cover?
Most vision insurance plans and FSAs provide coverage for:

items: A frame or lens allowance for [[a href="/eyeglasses-frames/designer-frames/"]]eyeglasses[[/a]]
Coverage or discounts on [[a href="/contact-lenses/"]]contact lenses[[/a]]
Co-pays or savings for specialty services like [[a href="/eye-care-services/emergency-eye-care/"]]emergency eye care[[/a]]
Pediatric eye care and vision screenings

blocks.html: If you’re enrolled in an FSA or HSA, you can also use pre-tax funds toward upgraded lenses, medical treatments, and a second pair of glasses or prescription sunglasses.
Not sure what your plan includes? Our staff will verify your benefits and walk you through your options before your appointment.
